Rule 1 (clean room): clean room items are denied by default. Exception: if the person is escorted by a facilities manager, it is granted instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if the person has been with the organization for more than 45 months, it is denied. But if, in addition, the person is not a contractor, it is granted after all. Further exception to the previous clause: if the person's home site is not the east campus, it is denied.
Rule 2 (rooftop): rooftop items are denied by default. Exception: if entry is requested after 9:00, it is granted instead. However, in that case, if the person is escorted by no one, it is denied. But if, in addition, safety training is not completed, it is granted after all. Further exception to the previous clause: if the person has more than 3 open security incidents, it is denied.
